How to play +

Spin to get a clue. Use the arrows above and below each reel to move one letter back or forwards through A–Z. Z wraps round to A. Each click costs one of your ten nudges.

Find the word before your nudges run out. Every puzzle starts within reach. There’s no timer, so take a moment to think.

Keyboard: Tab to a reel, then use ↑ or ↓. Use ← and → to move between reels. You can also swipe a reel up or down.
